summary: Korucust pairs recurring spell attacks with a transformation at 40% health.

abilities.name: Cloud and Vengeance
abilities.summary: Two linked casts pressure the current tank.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Prepare for Cloud of Oblivion ten seconds after the pull, then once each minute.
Korucust's Vengeance follows the cloud by two seconds.
At 40%, Korucust casts Phantasmal Shift. Keep tank control through the transition.
